newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary bourse approves Quaestor listing on BSE.
newsitem.headline: Hungary bourse approves Quaestor listing on BSE.

text.p: Hungarian securities trading company Quaestor Ertekpapirkereskedelmi es Befektetesi Rt was granted conditional approval to list its shares on the Budapest Stock Exchange (BSE) the bourse said on Tuesday.
"The date of the first day of trading will be established once the company meets the requirements," a BCE council statement said on Tuesday.

Quaestor director Laszlo Somlai told Reuters the conditions were mostly technical in nature, relating to items such as the physical issue of the papers, and added that he expected the listing to start soon.
"We expect the listing to occur at the end of January or the beginning of February," he said.
Somlai added that the company shares were originally issued at 2,500 forints each but the bourse listing price will be "somewhat higher".
Quaestor, which has registered capital of 616 million forints, will be the 48th company to be listed on the BSE.
